title: Process Kill Proof Gate HowTo
desc: Procedure for identifying and safely terminating one process when multiple repositories share the same executable.
steps: PRECHECK: Run wktasklist -V and tasklist full format output; prefer the cached wktasklist view when available.
IDENTIFY: Locate the exact PID and record image name, full command line, working directory, parent PID, owner, session number, and console host.
MATCH: Compare those fields with the intended Codex session and repository. Treat absent command line or working directory as unknown, not as a match.
DRY RUN: Run the sanctioned wkappbot taskkill dry-run for the exact PID. Do not use raw Stop-Process or taskkill for a cross-repository process.
APPROVAL: If the target is outside the current working directory or ownership is uncertain, stop and obtain explicit approval before any termination.
POSTCHECK: Re-run wktasklist -V and verify only the named PID exited. Report the precheck and postcheck evidence.
REGRESSION: A test must fail when an identical codex.exe image is selected by name or PID without repository command-line proof.
NAVIGATION: Read harness-process-kill-proof-gate for the reflex and harness-process-kill-proof-gate-ref for the incident record.

requirements.expect: full CommandLine and PID fields are shown
exact target classification is printed without termination
missing identity fields produce a proof-missing refusal
